content:
leo: Heads-up — our async ingestion task crashed last night with a JSONDecodeError coming from the SDK when the upstream returned a 422 as plain text. No RedwoodAPIError surfaced so the job couldn't handle it.
maya: that's bad. can you paste minimal repro or headers?
leo: saw response: Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8, status 422, body: "validation: email missing"
leo: code path: await client._http.post('/v1/items', json=payload) then client layers expect resp.json() and parse keys.
tina: we've got two problems here: (1) SDK assumes error bodies are JSON and raises JSONDecodeError on parse failure, (2) retry middleware treats any exception as retryable which retries 4xxs.
ben: +1. suggest: convert non-2xx into a typed exception (RedwoodAPIError) that contains status_code, message, raw_body, request_id and an is_retryable flag. That way callers and retry middleware can make informed decisions.
maya: implementation details: in http._handle_resp try: body = await resp.json() except JSONDecodeError: raw = await resp.text(); body = None; then if resp.status >= 200 < 300: return body or raw; else: msg = body.get('detail') if isinstance(body, dict) and 'detail' in body else raw; raise RedwoodAPIError(resp.status, msg, raw_body=raw, request_id=resp.headers.get('x-request-id'))
ben: and update retry policy: only retry on network errors or err.is_retryable (status >= 500). Do not treat JSONDecodeError from a 4xx as a network failure.
tina: tests to add: 1) json problem document 422 -> parsed fields; 2) text/plain 422 -> raw_body present and not retried; 3) 503 -> marked retryable and actually retried; 4) ensure sync client parity.
leo: will this change break user code that catches JSONDecodeError? probably, but it's better to provide structured exceptions. Add docs example for catching RedwoodAPIError.
ci-bot: Created issue #2418: "py sdk: normalize error shape for non-json bodies & tighten retry conditions"
maya: assigning to ben/tina for PR. thanks all — this should stop our noisy retries and crashed tasks. :thumbsup:
